description: This file contains core functions for matching, comparing, and manipulating Git trees and their object identifiers, including scoring for similarity, filling tree descriptions from object database, and tree splice and shift operations.

methods.name: int score_missing(unsigned mode)
methods.description: Calculates a score indicating the likelihood of a missing file/directory based on its mode.

methods.name: int score_differs(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Assigns a score based on how much modes differ between two objects.

methods.name: int score_matches(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Calculates a high score indicating similarity when modes match, with special handling for directories and symlinks.

methods.name: void * fill_tree_desc_strict(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * hash)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the ODB and initializes a tree description structure.

methods.name: int score_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2)
methods.description: Compares two trees and returns a score indicating their similarity.

methods.name: void match_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,int * best_score,char ** best_match,const char * base,int recurse_limit)
methods.description: Recursively compares subtrees and updates the best match and score between two tree objects.

methods.name: int splice_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid1,const char * prefix,const struct object_id * oid2,struct object_id * result)
methods.description: Replaces a subtree at a given prefix within a tree with another tree object.

methods.name: void shift_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,int depth_limit)
methods.description: Attempts to shift a tree's structure to better match another tree by prefixing or unprefixing subtrees.

methods.name: void shift_tree_by(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,const char * shift_prefix)
methods.description: Shifts a tree structure by a specified prefix, either adding or removing directory levels to improve match.

methods.name: int base_name_entries_compare(const struct name_entry * a,const struct name_entry * b)
